class.name: IvyGenerator
class.brief_description: Deterministic procedural ivy growth simulator on a planar wall surface.
class.description: [IvyGenerator] coordinates the Layer 1 procedural ivy simulation without making any mesh or rendering assumptions. Configure [member settings], define the planar simulation domain via [method set_wall], provide a grayscale attraction map via [method set_attraction_image], and optionally specify explicit start points or target waypoints before calling [method generate]. The simulation runs in two phases: Phase 1 steps all active vine tips up to [member IvySettings.max_steps] iterations with momentum, upward tropism, seeded wander, damped surface-gradient attraction and contour adherence, branching, spatial self-avoidance, pipe-model vascular thickening, and dead-branch withering. Phase 2 automatically connects any still-unsatisfied target waypoints via deterministic lateral tendrils from the closest existing graph points. After [method generate] succeeds, read the resulting tree topology as parallel packed arrays via [method get_point_positions], [method get_point_thicknesses], and [method get_point_parent_indices]. To let vines enter naturally from off-screen or climb sideways/downward, overscan the wall bounds (adjusting [code]uv_scale[/code] and [code]uv_offset[/code] to keep the attraction map aligned) or rotate [code]axis_u[/code] and [code]axis_v[/code].

method.name: clear_start_points
method.description: Clears all explicit starting positions configured via [method set_start_points].

method.name: clear_target_points
method.description: Clears all target waypoints configured via [method set_target_points].

method.name: generate
method.description: Executes the deterministic ivy growth simulation and populates the output graph arrays. Validates that [member settings] is assigned, the wall and attraction image are valid, [member IvySettings.start_count] and [member IvySettings.max_steps] are positive, the number of explicit start points does not exceed [member IvySettings.start_count], and all explicit start points and target points lie on the wall surface. Any remaining starts up to [member IvySettings.start_count] are placed deterministically along the bottom edge of the wall ([code]v = 0[/code]). Runs Phase 1 stepping followed by mandatory Phase 2 target connection. Returns [code]true[/code] on success; clears all previous results and returns [code]false[/code] on validation or capacity failure (such as exhausting [member IvySettings.max_points] before reaching all targets).

method.name: get_point_count
method.description: Returns the total number of points generated by the last successful [method generate] call, or [code]0[/code] if no valid results are present.

method.name: get_point_parent_indices
method.description: Returns the parent index for each point in the generated graph. Root points have a parent index of [code]-1[/code], and all child points satisfy [code]parent_index < child_index[/code].

method.name: get_point_positions
method.description: Returns the 3D world-space position of every point in the generated graph, indexed identically to [method get_point_thicknesses] and [method get_point_parent_indices].

method.name: get_point_thicknesses
method.description: Returns the radial thickness of every point in the generated graph after vascular thickening and dead-branch withering.

method.name: get_reached_target_count
method.description: Returns the total number of configured target waypoints satisfied within [member IvySettings.target_acceptance_radius] in the last successful [method generate] run.

method.name: get_start_points
method.description: Returns the explicit 3D starting positions currently configured on the generator.

method.name: get_target_count
method.description: Returns the number of target waypoints evaluated in the last successful [method generate] run, or [code]0[/code] if none were set or the last run failed.

method.name: get_target_points
method.description: Returns the 3D target waypoints currently configured on the generator.

method.name: is_target_reached
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param target_index] is valid and that target waypoint was reached within [member IvySettings.target_acceptance_radius] during the last successful [method generate] run.

method.name: set_attraction_image
method.description: Loads a grayscale scalar guidance map used for attraction gradient ascent and contour adherence. Supports [constant Image.FORMAT_L8], [constant Image.FORMAT_RGB8], and [constant Image.FORMAT_RGBA8] (validating that [code]R == G == B[/code]). Images are sampled with toroidal wrapping and bilinear filtering. Updates atomically: returns [code]false[/code] without discarding a previously loaded valid image if [param image] is null, empty, or invalid.

method.name: set_start_points
method.description: Sets explicit 3D root starting positions on the wall plane. Validated during [method generate]; if fewer than [member IvySettings.start_count] points are provided, the remainder are generated deterministically along the wall base ([code]v = 0[/code]).

method.name: set_target_points
method.description: Sets optional 3D target waypoints on the wall plane. Active tips steer softly toward nearby unsatisfied targets during Phase 1, and any remaining targets are connected in Phase 2 so every target is reached within [member IvySettings.target_acceptance_radius].

method.name: set_wall
method.description: Configures the oriented planar wall surface where [param origin] is the bottom-left corner, [param axis_u] and [param axis_v] are unit orthogonal tangent vectors along width and height, and [param uv_scale]/[param uv_offset] map local coordinates onto attraction-map UVs. Requires finite positive [param width] and [param height], non-zero [param uv_scale] components, and orthonormal [param axis_u] and [param axis_v]. Updates atomically, preserving any prior valid wall if validation fails.

members.member: The [IvySettings] resource controlling seed, stepping, steering weights, branching, thickening/withering, crowding avoidance, and target behavior.
